about: Master reference list of the Paper 3A manuscript (paper/tex/main.tex, si.tex). Entries are copied from the literature journals in research/ (lit_3a_classical.md C, lit_3a_ml.md L, lit_3a_calorimetry.md K), where each was checked on Crossref or OpenAlex when the journal was written (2026-10). Source style (Nature-like): Au, I., Au, I. \& Au, I. Title. \textit{J. Abbr.} \textbf{Vol}, Page (Year). doi:... build_ms.py writes refs_main.tex and refs_si.tex in order of first citation. NOT YET AUDITED LIVE for the manuscript: every entry must pass the live reference audit (queued for Claude Science) before submission; open items are listed in 'open'. The journal style is applied after the venue is chosen (T7).

open.trezza2022: The journal cites arXiv:2111.09602; the version of record is npj Comput. Mater. 8 (2022), doi:10.1038/s41524-022-00806-7 (lit_3a_ml.md). Cite the version of record; check that it keeps the Al-fumarate rescaling at 298, 313 and 333 K.
